description.sv: Gratis tredagarsevent i Portland med street- och parktävlingar i världsklass, kombinerat med livemusik (bl.a. Hot Mulligan, PUP, Basement, Angel Du$t).
description.en: Free three-day event in Portland featuring world-class street and park skateboard contests, combined with live music (including Hot Mulligan, PUP, Basement, Angel Du$t).
